title: Raw stage Kan-extension diagram and compatible comparison
statement: Let $J$ be a small filtered category, $F:J\to\mathrm{Cat}$ a diagram of small categories, and $V$ a cocone with vertex $C$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Let $P_j$ and $Q$ be precoverages on $F(j)$ and $C$. Every transition functor $F(a)$ and cocone functor $V_j$ is continuous for the generated topologies [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Fix $i\in J$ and a set-valued sheaf $G$ on $P_i$. Write $I=\mathrm{Under}(i)$, $A_t=F(t.hom)_sG$, and $H=V_{i,s}G$. For $b:t\to t'$ give a sheaf map $\theta_b:A_t\to F(b.right)^s A_{t'}$ whose composite with the unit $G\to F(t.hom)^s A_t$ equals the unit at $t'$ componentwise as objects of the arrow category of sets. Give $\alpha_t:A_t\to V_t^sH$ whose composites with the stage units equal the unit for $V_i$ componentwise as arrow objects. There exist a presheaf diagram $B:I\to\mathrm{PSh}(C)$, morphisms $\beta_t:A_t\to V_t^p B_t$, and a natural transformation $\gamma:B\to\mathrm{const}(H)$ with the following properties. Here $V_t=V_{t.right}$ and $V_t^p$ is presheaf restriction. Each $\beta_t$ is a universal left Kan unit: composition with it bijects maps $B_t\to T$ with maps $A_t\to V_t^p T$ for every presheaf $T$. For all $b:t\to t'$ and $X\in F(t.right)$, $\beta_t(X)B(b)(V_tX)=\theta_b(X)\beta_{t'}(F(b.right)X)$ as objects of $\mathrm{Arrow}(\mathrm{Set})$. Finally $\beta_t(X)\gamma_t(V_tX)=\alpha_t(X)$ for every $t,X$. No sheaf condition or isomorphism after sheafification is asserted. The universal units and their factorization equations determine these objects and maps up to compatible isomorphism.

proof.text: Construct each B_t by the left Kan extension of A_t along V_t.op. Its universal unit beta_t is a genuine categorical construction, not data chosen from mere existence. Extend theta_b followed by beta_tprime along this universal property after transporting V.w. Uniqueness of adjuncts under the given theta unit equations proves identity and composition, so these extensions form the presheaf diagram B.

proof.text: Extend alpha_t by the Kan universal property to gamma_t. The composite of theta_b and the later alpha has the same composite with the stage unit as the earlier alpha by htheta and halpha. Injectivity of the stage adjunction hom equivalence proves these sheaf maps equal. Kan uniqueness then proves the extensions gamma_t natural in t. The factorization equation is precisely the Kan-unit equation. This finishes construction of B, beta, and gamma; neither sheafness nor a sheafification comparison is claimed here.
